subject: Thoughts after our demo — one quick question
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@novacorp.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Jun 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Thoughts after our demo — one quick question

Hi Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today to walk through your inference needs and the two key scenarios (real-time customer responses + nightly batch embeddings). I wanted to capture the two quick outcomes we discussed and ask one focused question so we can align next steps.

Recap (2 bullets):
- Primary goal: reduce per-request latency under 150ms for customer-facing flows while dropping inference cost per 1k requests by ~30%.
- Constraints: procurement prefers pilot-sized spend under $25k; security ok with VPC but wants audit logs and SOC2 evidence.

One quick question for you: which of these is the main blocker to moving to a pilot?
A) Predictable cost (unit economics / budget)
B) Tight latency / SLOs for customer flows

If you can reply with either A or B (one word), I’ll put together the right next step:
- If A: I’ll send a short evaluation kit + ballpark pricing and a suggested pilot scope for procurement.
- If B: I’ll schedule a 15-min technical sync with our latency engineer (Alex cc’d) and share a micro-benchmark plan.

Attached: redwood-one-pager.pdf (one-page summary + pilot options).

Happy to pause if now isn’t the right time — just want to make sure we’re not sending the wrong follow-up.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com | (415) 555-0128

--

Hi Tom —

Quick nudge in case my note got buried. Two-second ask: A or B as an answer (predictable cost vs latency). Either is fine — I’ll take it from there.

If it helps, I can also schedule a short time to walk procurement through the pilot options (we’ve done a bunch of pilots inside the $15–25k window).

Thanks,
Jonas

P.S. Alex is standing by to jump on a technical call if you pick B — he has a sub-15ms path we can demo on comparable infra.

From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@novacorp.com>

Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 09:05:00 -0700

Jonas —

Thanks for the follow-ups and the concise recap. Apologies for the delay; we’ve been finalizing our Q3 budget. Short answer: A (predictable cost) is the gating factor for us right now.

Please send the evaluation kit and a ballpark for a pilot that hits the $20k budget. I’m out next week but will review the materials and loop in procurement. If you could include a one-paragraph note we can forward to procurement that would help.
